metafields.description: Metafield values, keyed by namespace then field key.
metafields.$comment: Intentionally unconstrained. Only the site's field definitions know what a given key accepts, so the shape is validated there; constraining it here would split validation across two layers that could disagree. The declaration exists so the property is not stripped as an unknown one.
